metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'fact_team_game'[is_back_to_back])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('fact_team_game'[result], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			"Matchs__équipe_", '_Mesures'[Matchs (équipe)],
			"Taux_de_victoire_à_domicile", IGNORE('_Mesures'[Taux de victoire à domicile])
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(1002, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'fact_team_game'[result], 0)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'fact_team_game'[result] DESC

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Facteurs'[Facteur],
			'Facteurs'[Ordre],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Taux_du_facteur", '_Mesures'[Taux du facteur]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Taux_du_facteur], 0, 'Facteurs'[Ordre], 1, 'Facteurs'[Facteur], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Taux_du_facteur] DESC, 'Facteurs'[Ordre], 'Facteurs'[Facteur]

			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Taux_de_victoire_en_back_to_back", '_Mesures'[Taux de victoire en back-to-back],
			"Taux_de_victoire_hors_back_to_back", '_Mesures'[Taux de victoire hors back-to-back]

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed =

	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('fact_team_game'[venue])),
			NOT('fact_team_game'[venue] IN {"Terrain neutre"})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('fact_team_game'[rest_bucket])),
			NOT('fact_team_game'[rest_bucket] IN {"Premier match"})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_season'[is_complete])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket],
			'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket_order],
			'fact_team_game'[venue],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			"Taux_de_victoire", '_Mesures'[Taux de victoire]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			101,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket], 'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket_order]),
			'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket_order],
			1,
			'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'fact_team_game'[venue])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'fact_team_game'[venue], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'fact_team_game'[venue],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinTaux_de_victoire", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Taux_de_victoire]),
		"MaxTaux_de_victoire", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Taux_de_victoire])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'fact_team_game'[venue]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket_order], 'fact_team_game'[rest_bucket], [ColumnIndex]
